<js>
let bookid = java.hexDecodeToString(result)

baseUrl = URL("/book/get_info_by_id", {
  book_id: bookid
});
let $ = decrypt(java.ajax(baseUrl)).data.book_info;

let name = $.book_name;
let author = $.author_name;
let kind = [
  $.category_name,
  $.up_status == '0' ? '连载中' : '已完结',
  $.is_paid == '0' ? 'FREE' : 'VIP'
];
let wordCount = $.total_word_count;
let lastChapter = $.last_chapter_info.chapter_title;
let lastChapterTime = $.last_chapter_info.uptime;
let coverUrl = $.cover;
let tocUrl = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(bookid)},{"type":"Text"}`;
let formatNum = (num) => {
  return +num < 10000 ? num : (+num / 10000).toFixed(1) + "万";
};
let tags = $.tag;
let description = $.description;
let intro = ` 更新日期：${lastChapterTime}
点击：${formatNum($.total_click)}　收藏：${$.total_favor}　月票：${$.total_yp}　推荐票：${$.total_recommend}　打赏：${formatNum($.reward_amount)}　催更：${$.total_blade}
标签：${tags}
简介：${description}`;

result = {
  name: name,
  author: author,
  kind: kind,
  wordCount: wordCount,
  lastChapter: lastChapter,
  intro: intro,
  coverUrl: coverUrl,
  tocUrl: tocUrl
};
JSON.stringify(result);
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
let {
  bookid,
  chapterid
} = JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result));
// java.log(`bookid= ${bookid}, chapterid= ${chapterid}`);

let r1 = decrypt(java.ajax(URL("/chapter/get_chapter_info", {
  chapter_id: chapterid
}))).data.chapter_info;
result = r1.txt_content;
if (r1.is_paid == 1 && r1.auth_access == 0) {
  result = `本章为VIP章节，请先订阅！购买章节 ${r1.unit_hlb}币\n\n${result}`
}

result
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let bookid = java.hexDecodeToString(result);

let url = URL(`/chapter/get_chapter_list_group_by_division`, {
  last_update_time: "0",
  book_id: bookid
});

let list = [];
let response = decrypt(java.ajax(url)).data;
let division_list = response.division_list;
let chapter_list_group = response.chapter_list_group;
// java.log(JSON.stringify(chapter_list));

chapter_list_group.map(chaplist => {
  list.push({
    title: division_list.find(item => item.division_id == chaplist.division_id).division_name,
    url: "",
    isVolume: true,
    isVip: false,
    isPay: false,
    ChapterInfo: "",
  })
  chaplist.chapter_list.map(chap => {
    let isVip = chap.is_paid === '1';
    let isPay = chap.auth_access == '1';

    list.push({
      title: chap.chapter_title,
      url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(JSON.stringify({
        bookid: bookid,
        chapterid: chap.chapter_id,
        isVip: isVip,
        isPay: isPay
      }))},{"type":"text"}`,
      isVolume: false,
      isVip: chap.is_paid === '1',
      isPay: chap.auth_access == '1',
      ChapterInfo: `#${chap.chapter_index}/ ${chap.is_paid == '1' ? (chap.auth_access == '1' ? "已购买" : "未购买") : "FREE"} ${chap.word_count}字  ${chap.uptime}`,
    })
  });
});

// list.map((item,index)=>java.log(`${index} == ${JSON.stringify(item)}\n`))
list
</js>
